outcome: A directly addressed unassigned GUARD_ALLY no longer promises or accepts a camp-craft request, while the eligible CAMP_RESIDENT accepts and completes the same native bandage craft.  A mixed broadcast reaches the eligible resident's native craft route without an ally promise.  The fresh source-bound run returned three bandages to CAMP_STORAGE.
summary: The initial contradiction was reproduced: R031 Route Ally 1, a GUARD_ALLY with no assigned camp, was placed in the LLM-hearer path and replied that bandages were under way.  The repair preserves direct camp handling for valid residents and, only for recognized camp-craft speech, excludes listeners that fail camp-routing eligibility or have no live camp from LLM enqueue.  Supporting semantic-surface repairs expose the native inventory selection/drop route and a current-camp board route for a completed off-map crafting worker; they do not issue guessed keys.  In fresh run 55098ec..., native food distribution used a saved tortilla (16,052 kcal); only gauze, duct tape, and antiseptic were debug-spawned as authorized zero-credit setup.  Katharina then accepted the one-kcal native craft, elapsed six game hours, returned through the advertised camp.return_crafting action, and CAMP_STORAGE contained three bandage entries.  The run was quit through its bound endpoint and the exact owned game PID exited.
material_changes: src/faction_camp.cpp makes the authoritative heard-camp-craft handler reject a listener that is not eligible for basecamp routing, lacks an assigned camp, or is not assigned to the addressed camp.

src/npctalk.cpp recognizes the narrow camp-craft grammar after direct-address stripping and keeps an ineligible or missing-camp listener out of llm_intent enqueue; ordinary non-craft follower speech remains on the LLM route.

src/inventory_ui.cpp keeps per-item inventory.toggle adjacent to inventory.select and emits one visible commit action; src/handle_action.cpp exposes native world.drop and permits the current accessible camp's assigned roster to open its native mission board even when a craft worker is off-map.

src/mission_companion.cpp exposes an enabled camp.return_crafting semantic action only when the native board has a completed crafting mission; tests/faction_camp_test.cpp and tests/pickup_semantic_test.cpp cover the relevant parser and selection surfaces.
